task_description: Write a method in Dafny to remove odd characters in a string.
specification_response:
method RemoveOddChars(s: string) returns (result: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
- The resulting string contains only characters from the input string that are not odd characters
- The length of the resulting string is less than or equal to the length of the input string
- All characters in the resulting string are characters from the input string
- For each character in the result, that character is not odd according to the character's Unicode code point (e.g., its code point is even)

Natural language description:
    - The resulting string contains only characters from the input string that are at even indices
- The length of the resulting string is equal to the number of even indices in the input string

Dafny specification:
    ensures |result| == ((|s| + 1) / 2)
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> s[2 * i] == result[i]
  
Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method RemoveOddCharacters(s: string) returns (result: string)
    ensures |result| == ((|s| + 1) / 2)
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> s[2 * i] == result[i]
{
    var res := "";
    var i := 0;
    while 2 * i < |s|
        invariant 0 <= i <= |s| / 2
        invariant |res| == i
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> s[2 * k] == res[k]
    {
        res := res + [s[2 * i]];
        i := i + 1;
    }
    return res;
}
```
